shares rose more than 5% on Monday as Citi said it has seen the fastest store growth in five months.

“Through Sept. 18 (Week 38), Store Leads suggests AppLovin has 13,105 global eCommerce clients, a 5.1% increase since last week,” Citi analyst Jason Bazinet wrote in a note to clients. “This was the fastest growth rate in five months. The increase was primarily driven by 165 new stores in the US (+2.9% w/w), ~285 new stores in Hong Kong (+17.3% w/w), and ~100 new stores in China (+72.5% w/w).”
Bazinet has a Buy rating and a $600 price target on AppLovin.

title: AppLovin pops as Citi sees fastest store growth in five months
